assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one grayscale axial chest CT image for a fictional game.
Image 1 is the EXACT anatomy and composition reference / edit target, a clean reference slice from the same existing game case. Create a higher-resolution, cleaner, naturally sharp CT depiction of this exact slice, visually close to this reference. Keep the same proportions, body envelope, lung shapes, vessels, airway branches, mediastinum, posterior vertebra and bone locations, the exact left-right orientation and same amount of black margin. Keep all existing fine lung structures and subtle markings in their original positions; do NOT invent, remove or relocate any lesion. Do NOT enlarge tiny spots into masses. This represents a surprisingly clear new reconstruction in a fictional narrative, not a real clinical study.
The lungs stay black with thin pale branching vessels; mediastinum and chest wall are pale, standard grayscale CT lung-window appearance. Preserve natural fine texture, avoid plastic smoothing, artificial edge outlines, fake sharpening halos or oversharpened grain. Improve clarity and readability relative to a noisy iteration, stay very close to the supplied cleaner reference. Full field of view, one square image, roughly 1024px, pure black surrounding canvas.
Absolutely NO text, no labels, no arrows, no circles, no split view, no decorative UI, no disclaimer, no logo or watermark.
assets.review: Compared with the source middle layer and generated original: similar field of view, lung/body silhouettes and major mediastinal structures, clearer vessels and low noise. This is an illustrated narrative result, not pixel-exact reconstruction, a clinical ground truth or measured network inference. No quantitative superiority or lesion-location task is attached.
